- Jessica Gorman: COND (-0.5, -0.6) — Authentic grief weaponized by political handlers.

Jessica Gorman unveiled a handmade bench at the GOP midterm convention in Dallas, intended for Congress, to honor her 18-year-old daughter Sheridan, who was killed by an undocumented immigrant.

The Poison:
Grief is weaponized into a political shield, turning a personal tragedy into a partisan cudgel that precludes nuanced immigration debate.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The analysis shifts from the Metaphysical (WHO is honored) to the Lyrical (WHY the tragedy is framed), exploiting raw emotional resonance to bypass logical policy scrutiny.

Social Physics Analysis:
The actors run a Smart Selfish Maneuver. They take a genuine human catastrophe, wrap it in righteous grief as a pretext, and project blame onto political opponents to score partisan points.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. F_pos < F_neg as cynical exploitation outweighs authentic healing.

The Unavoidable Truth: Parental grief over a murdered child is an absolute human tragedy.
The Unavoidable Lie: Staging that grief at a partisan convention solves border security or prevents crime.
